description: Defines a data class 'Product' representing the product domain model in an online shopping platform. Includes fields for product attributes, a computed property 'title', and a method 'priceText' for UI display purposes.

classes.name: Product
classes.description: A data class modeling a product with attributes like id, name, description, price, category, and timestamps. Includes a computed property 'title' and a method 'priceText' for formatting the price for UI display.

methods.name: priceText
methods.description: Formats the product's price as a currency string with a dollar sign and two decimal places.
